The ritual

From bean to table

  1. 01

    Call

    Tell us what's wrong — a leak, a clog, no hot water. A photo of the problem helps us arrive prepared, with the right parts on the truck.

  2. 02

    Diagnose

    We find the problem and quote the fix before any work starts. You approve the price first — nothing happens without your say-so.

  3. 03

    Fix

    Most repairs are done in one visit — service calls run 30–90 minutes. We fix it, test it, and clean up before we leave.

  4. 04

    Done

    Clean tools, tidy finish, and a written workmanship guarantee. If something we fixed fails, we come back and make it right.

    Good to know

    Before you come.

    What to expect

    Your table is waiting if you booked; walk-ins take the next free one. Order at the table, food comes out when it's ready, and the bill comes when you ask for it.

    Duration

    Most tables are in and out in about an hour; a slow dinner with friends, two. Tell us if you're in a rush and we'll pace it to your evening.

    Our guarantee

    Tell your server and we'll make it again or take it off the bill — no argument, no awkwardness.
